summary: Every factual claim in the report matches the checks, crawl, snapshot and screenshots, and nothing broken was hidden, because nothing was broken.

claims.claim: Built using the Umbraco MCP server
claims.evidence: check.json process.intendedChannel: 'built through mcp'; grade.md calls the run strictly MCP-only

claims.claim: Front page with Block Grid hero and post-listing blocks
claims.evidence: check.json site.usesBlockGrid and schema.blockGridOnPages (blogFrontPage); grade.md lists blogHeroBlock and postListingBlock; the frontpage screenshot shows the hero and a two-card listing

claims.claim: Two published MCP articles, each using article-header and rich-text blocks
claims.evidence: check.json content.twoBlogPosts (2 posts) and content.allPublished; grade.md says each blogPost grid is articleHeaderBlock + richTextBlock; the blogpost screenshot matches

claims.claim: Three local Unsplash images imported into a `Blog` media folder
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia (3 items), content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos (3 of 3), content.mediaInFolders, site.imagesFromMediaLibrary (0 hot-linked); uSync Media/blog.config exists; grade.md confirms the Blog media folder

claims.claim: Schema exported through uSync; no migrations added
claims.evidence: check.json changes list uSync v18 ContentTypes/DataTypes configs; code.noMigrationsWritten ok

claims.claim: .NET and frontend builds pass with zero warnings
claims.evidence: check.json build.ok with 0 errors and 0 warnings; code.frontendBuilt shows wwwroot/dist/site.css exists. Frontend warning count is not separately checked but nothing contradicts it

claims.claim: All pages, CSS, blocks, and signed image crops return HTTP 200
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: all 3 pages 200, site.css 200, all 5 image assets 200 with hmac-signed URLs; site.noUnsignedResizeUrls ok
44317 appears in snapshot.json and the transcript; check.json content.domainAssigned shows '/'

claims.claim: Nothing else is known to be broken (only a dev-certificate warning)
claims.evidence: check.json 42/42 passed; screenshots show a fully styled, working site; grade.md issues are about modeling and design choices, not breakage
